title: Member Terms: Ways to Pay and How the Statement Arrives on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
Money reaches a Crop Input Purchasing Account only by the routes the member's programme allows, is applied in the order that programme fixes, and the statement reaches the member by the channel shown.

| Programme | Ways to pay | Grain settlement proceeds onto the account | Order a payment is applied in | Statement reaches the member by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | check; ACH; credit card | not allowed | oldest invoice first | counter printout |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | check; ACH; credit card; grain settlement transfer | allowed | oldest invoice first | mailed statement |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | check; ACH; credit card; grain settlement transfer | allowed | oldest invoice first | mailed statement |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | check; ACH; grain settlement transfer; prepay application | allowed | prepay first, then oldest invoice | emailed statement |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | check; ACH; grain settlement transfer; prepay application | allowed | prepay first, then oldest invoice | portal and email |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | check; ACH; grain settlement transfer; prepay application | allowed | prepay first, then oldest invoice | portal and email |

**Ways to pay.** A route that does not appear in a programme's row is a route that programme does not take. Card payment falls away above the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account, and the drawing down of money already held to the member's credit is a route only on the three programmes that hold prepay.

**Grain settlement proceeds.** The Cash Purchase Account does not take grain settlement proceeds onto the account; every other programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts does.

**Order of application.** On an oldest-invoice-first order the oldest open invoice is cleared in full before any of the next. On a prepay-first order, prepay standing to the member's credit is drawn before their own money is taken.

**Statement channel.** The channel rises with the programme: a printout handed over at the counter, a mailed statement, an emailed statement, and the member portal together with email on the two whole-farm programmes.
